issue_request: FHIR-12287 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked that code-system rendering expose alternative relationships such as the component hierarchy because the old v3 AddressPartType page showed subsumption but not component relationships.
initial_application: Jira comments identify svn r10050. Git-svn commit ce3aad59b773b1c5c8cba55ef9066014e83350be is that revision and updated ValueSetImporterV3 to detect ComponentOf in v3 MIF, add a partOf/ComponentOf property, and render a PartOf column for affected v3 code systems.
additional_context: FHIR-5947 is an earlier supporting terminology decision clarifying that code-system child relationships are not always subsumption and discussing AddressPartType/ComponentOf. Current core source defines general CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning and the concept-properties partOf property, but no longer contains the historical ValueSetImporterV3 converter or a v3-AddressPartType source artifact. The current published THO AddressPartType page already renders ComponentOf as a property and as a concepts-table column. A 2019 UTG Zulip thread discusses ComponentOf/AddressPartType as UTG terminology work.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is appropriate in the current FHIR core checkout because the target v3 code system rendering belongs to THO/UTG and is already visible there.
